summary.text: Spear tip bamboo is a thick bamboo named for its triangular, spear-point leaves, found in cloud bamboo mountain range.

claims.text: Cloud bamboo mountain range has no trees, only spear tip bamboo. The stalks are as thick as giant trees, and the leaves are triangular with a long base and a thin, sharp, tough tip. Mortals pluck those leaves and tie them to wooden rods to make spears, which is why the bamboo is called spear tip bamboo. The forest covers the whole mountain range and holds many cloud path lifeforms, especially cloud foxes. Deep in the range, a giant spear tip bamboo over twenty meters tall nurtures a wild wood path Immortal Gu nearly finished forming.

At cloud bamboo mountain range, Fang Yuan takes eleven desolate plants of three species, including desolate plant spear tip bamboo alongside cloud qi root and white hair root. The remaining spear tip bamboos he still seeks are ordinary Gu materials; the desolate plant spear tip bamboos are already taken. Relocating them into an immortal aperture without damage needs delicate wood path methods, because other paths carve foreign dao marks and lower quality even when temporary. The roots run fifty to sixty feet deep, so specific methods are required to move them intact. After leaving Mini Northern Plains, his time path clone reaches Mini Central Continent, then plants spear tip bamboos on barren land southeast of contact heart river bank while releasing cloud foxes, aiming to build a cloud bamboo forest without a mountain range.
When Myriad Destruction Lightning Forest strikes Cloud Bamboo Mountain, eleven desolate plant spear tip bamboos are wiped out along with a vast number of ordinary spear tip bamboos.
